app.commerce-customer.title: Commerce Customer
app.commerce-customer.state.empty: Open a customer to see and edit everything about them in one place.
app.commerce-customer.overview.hint: Read-only mirror of the customer in Shopify. Editing lives in the Marketing & tax, Tags and Note sections; writes go to Shopify and the mirror follows via webhook.
app.commerce-customer.marketing.hint: These two Shopify-owned fields are written to Shopify (Admin API) on Save; the mirror follows via webhook.
app.commerce-customer.marketing.consentH: When on, the customer consents to email marketing (single opt-in). Turn off to unsubscribe.
app.commerce-customer.marketing.taxExemp: When on, the customer is exempt from tax on their orders.
app.commerce-customer.tags.hint: The customer's Shopify tags. VIP is just a tag — add it here to flag a customer. Save writes the tags to Shopify.
app.commerce-customer.note.hint: The internal note stored on the customer in Shopify.
app.commerce-customer.addresses.hint: The customer's address book (read-only). The default address is flagged.
app.commerce-customer.hint.adminApiOff: The Shopify Admin API is disabled (see Commerce settings) — customer edits cannot be written.
app.commerce-customer.confirm.saveMsg: Write your changes to "{name}" to Shopify?
app.commerce-customer.confirm.note: The change is written to Shopify via the Admin API; the CMS mirror is re-ingested asynchronously by webhook.
app.commerce-customer.status.saved: Saved to Shopify. The mirror follows via webhook.
app.commerce-customer.dialog.title: Unsaved Changes
app.commerce-customer.dialog.body1: You have unsaved changes to this customer.
app.commerce-customer.dialog.body2: Do you want to save them to Shopify first?
